items_all.title: Sam Altman meets with Samsung leadership to secure more RAM for data centers amid crushing shortages
items_all.summary: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman met with around 50 Samsung executives in South Korea on October 31 to discuss AI's future, business opportunities and the technology's impact on corporate operations. The meeting comes as demand for memory chips grows alongside AI infrastructure spending, putting pressure on global DRAM supplies. Samsung and SK hynix together accounted for approximately 83% of global high-bandwidth memory revenue in the second quarter of 2026, highlighting South Korea's central role in supplying the hardware behind the AI expansion.
items_all.title_original: Sam Altman meets with Samsung leadership to secure more RAM for data centers amid crushing shortages
items_all.title_en: Sam Altman meets with Samsung leadership to secure more RAM for data centers amid crushing shortages
items_all.title_zh: Sam Altman 与三星领导层会面，在严重短缺的情况下为数据中心获取更多 RAM
items_all.title_bilingual: Sam Altman 与三星领导层会面，在严重短缺的情况下为数据中心获取更多 RAM / Sam Altman meets with Samsung leadership to secure more RAM for data centers amid crushing shortages
items_all.summary_zh: OpenAI 首席执行官 Sam Altman 于 10 月 31 日在韩国会见了约 50 名三星高管，讨论人工智能的未来、商业机会以及该技术对企业运营的影响。此次会议召开之际，存储芯片的需求随着人工智能基础设施支出的增长而增长，给全球 DRAM 供应带来压力。 2026 年第二季度，三星和 SK 海力士合计约占全球高带宽内存收入的 83%，凸显了韩国在提供人工智能扩张背后的硬件方面的核心作用。

items_all.title: Open-source USB tool unlocks Nvidia's half-speed GPU AI limiter on Windows
items_all.summary: An open-source UEFI tool, nv-uefi-unlocker, lifts Nvidia’s tensor rate cap on RTX 20, 30, and 40-series GPUs under Windows.

items_all.title_en: Open-source USB tool unlocks Nvidia's half-speed GPU AI limiter on Windows
items_all.title_zh: 开源 USB 工具在 Windows 上解锁 Nvidia 的半速 GPU AI 限制器
items_all.title_bilingual: 开源 USB 工具在 Windows 上解锁 Nvidia 的半速 GPU AI 限制器 / Open-source USB tool unlocks Nvidia's half-speed GPU AI limiter on Windows
items_all.summary_zh: 开源 UEFI 工具 nv-uefi-unlocker 提高了 Windows 下 Nvidia 在 RTX 20、30 和 40 系列 GPU 上的张量速率上限。
